description: This file defines API handlers for managing subscriptions in the focalboard server, including creating, deleting, and retrieving user subscriptions, with route registration and audit logging.

classes.name: API
classes.description: API handler struct for subscription-related endpoints

methods.name: registerSubscriptionsRoutes
methods.description: Registers subscription API routes with the provided router.

methods.name: handleCreateSubscription
methods.description: Handles creation of a new subscription for a user to a block.

methods.name: handleDeleteSubscription
methods.description: Handles deletion of a user's subscription to a block.

methods.name: handleGetSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all subscriptions for a specific user.
